common_fields.name: Study_ID
common_fields.label: Study ID
common_fields.description: Unique ID string, [Author][Year]_Exp[1-9].

common_fields.name: Parent_Study_ID
common_fields.label: Parent Study ID
common_fields.description: Study_ID of the record one level up in the hierarchy (experiment -> paper/study). Null for a top-level record.  The per-record aggregation level was removed on 2026-09-17; every extraction record now describes one experiment and carries its own DV contrasts.

common_fields.name: Year
common_fields.label: Publication Year
common_fields.description: Publication year.

common_fields.name: Publication
common_fields.label: Publication
common_fields.description:
Form of the publication.
paper_peer_reviewed - Paper (peer-reviewed): journal article that passed external peer review
paper_unreviewed - Paper (unreviewed): article without external peer review
thesis - Thesis: master's-level thesis
dissertation - Dissertation: doctoral dissertation
preprint - Preprint: author-shared, not yet peer reviewed
working_paper - Working paper: institute working paper
conference_paper - Conference paper: proceedings or presentation
unpublished_manuscript - Unpublished manuscript: not published anywhere
report - Report: institutional or technical report

common_fields.name: DOI
common_fields.label: DOI
common_fields.description: Digital Object Identifier, or null.

common_fields.name: Authors
common_fields.label: Authors
common_fields.description: Author names (Last, First), semicolon-separated.

common_fields.name: Title
common_fields.label: Title
common_fields.description: Title of the paper.

common_fields.name: Study_Description
common_fields.label: Study Description
common_fields.description: 2-sentence description of the study design and primary aim.

common_fields.name: N_Recruited
common_fields.label: N Recruited
common_fields.description: Number of participants recruited before exclusions, or null.

common_fields.name: N_Analyzed
common_fields.label: N Analyzed
common_fields.description: Final analyzed sample size, or null.

common_fields.name: N_Reported_Per_Condition
common_fields.label: N Reported Per Condition
common_fields.description:
Does the paper print the per-condition sample sizes?
0 - not reported (must be inferred): sizes must be derived from the total N
1 - cell sizes explicitly reported: every condition's n is printed

common_fields.name: N_Inference_Method
common_fields.label: N Inference Method
common_fields.description:
How the per-condition sample sizes were obtained.
1 - Reported: cell sizes printed as-is
2 - Equal split of total N: assumed n = N / arms
3 - Other (say how in the Rationale Notes): any other derivation - state it in Rationale Notes

options.label: Other (say how in the Rationale Notes)

common_fields.name: Age_Mean
common_fields.label: Mean Age
common_fields.description: Numeric mean age, or null (leave null when only a median/range/category is reported).

common_fields.name: Age_SD
common_fields.label: Age SD
common_fields.description: Standard deviation of age, or null.

common_fields.name: Age_Reported_As
common_fields.label: Age Reported As
common_fields.description:
How the paper reports age.
1 - Mean/SD: mean with standard deviation
2 - Median/Range: median and/or range
3 - Categorical band: age brackets (e.g. 18-25)
4 - Not reported: no age information

common_fields.name: Age_Group
common_fields.label: Age Group
common_fields.description:
Age group of the sample.
1 - Children: under ~13
2 - Adolescents: roughly 13-17
3 - Adults: 18 and over
4 - Mixed: more than one age group

common_fields.name: Gender_Ratio
common_fields.label: Gender Ratio
common_fields.description: Object mapping gender labels to percentages or counts, e.g. {"female": 59, "male": 40, "non-binary": 1}; null if not reported.

common_fields.name: Gender_Reported_As
common_fields.label: Gender Reported As
common_fields.description:
How the paper reports gender.
1 - Percentages: shares per gender
2 - Counts: numbers per gender
3 - Not reported: no gender breakdown

common_fields.name: Covariates
common_fields.label: Covariates
common_fields.description: Array of objects listing variables controlled for, [{"covariate": string, "dv_name": string, "r_val": number|null}]. Empty array if none.

common_fields.name: Country
common_fields.label: Countries
common_fields.description: Array of country strings, e.g. ["USA", "UK"]. Empty array if not reported.

common_fields.name: Sample_Region
common_fields.label: Sample Region
common_fields.description: Region/description when Country is not applicable (e.g. "international English-speaking", "Sub-Saharan Africa").

common_fields.name: International_Sample
common_fields.label: International Sample
common_fields.description:
Does the sample span more than one country?
0 - single country
1 - sample spans multiple countries

common_fields.name: WEIRD_Western
common_fields.label: WEIRD - Western
common_fields.description:
WEIRD-W: is the sample Western? Leave empty when unclear.
0 - not: not a Western sample
1 - Western: Western country or population

common_fields.name: WEIRD_Educated
common_fields.label: WEIRD - Educated
common_fields.description:
WEIRD-E: is the sample highly educated? Leave empty when unclear.
0 - not: not education-heavy
1 - Educated/high-education: university-heavy or highly educated

common_fields.name: WEIRD_Industrialized
common_fields.label: WEIRD - Industrialized
common_fields.description:
WEIRD-I: industrialized economy? Leave empty when unclear.
0 - not: not industrialized
1 - Industrialized: industrialized economy

common_fields.name: WEIRD_Rich
common_fields.label: WEIRD - Rich
common_fields.description:
WEIRD-R: rich / high-income? Leave empty when unclear.
0 - not: not high-income
1 - Rich/high-income: rich economy

common_fields.name: WEIRD_Democratic
common_fields.label: WEIRD - Democratic
common_fields.description:
WEIRD-D: democratic political system? Leave empty when unclear.
0 - not: not democratic
1 - Democratic: democratic system

common_fields.name: Setting
common_fields.label: Setting
common_fields.description:
Where the study ran.
1 - Lab: controlled laboratory setting
2 - Field: real-world setting
3 - Classroom: school or university class
4 - Online panel survey: paid panel (Prolific/MTurk) survey
5 - Online experiment: web-hosted experiment
6 - Simulated field: mock feed/site inside the study
7 - Other: say which in the notes

common_fields.name: dataset_availability_status
common_fields.label: Dataset Availability Status
common_fields.description:
Are the study data public?
1 - Open URL: direct download link given
2 - Upon request: available on request only
3 - Not available: no data access
4 - Not stated: the paper says nothing

common_fields.name: data_url
common_fields.label: Data URL
common_fields.description: Direct URL to the dataset, or null.

common_fields.name: data_repository
common_fields.label: Data Repository
common_fields.description: Repository name/ID (e.g. OSF ujwy3, Dryad, Zenodo), or null.

common_fields.name: data_available
common_fields.label: Data Available (derived)
common_fields.description: Derived, not paper-coded: 1 when a harmonized participant-level dataset exists in `Datasets/<Study Key>/`, else 0. Populated by the reanalysis / analysis-suite scripts (`Scripts/suite_common.py:_data_available_map`).

common_fields.name: code_available
common_fields.label: Code Available
common_fields.description:
Is analysis code available? Leave empty when not stated.
0 - not: no code offered
1 - analysis code available: code is shared

common_fields.name: preregistration_status
common_fields.label: Preregistration Status
common_fields.description:
Was the analysis preregistered?
1 - None: no preregistration
2 - Registered (no URL given): registered, no link printed
3 - Registered (URL given): registered with a link

common_fields.name: preregistration_url
common_fields.label: Preregistration URL
common_fields.description: URL of the preregistration, or null.

common_fields.name: ethics
common_fields.label: Ethics Approval
common_fields.description:
How is ethics approval reported?
0 - No mention: nothing said
1 - Mentioned: approval stated
2 - Institution named: the board/committee is named
3 - Institution and protocol number: full approval details

common_fields.name: consent_reported
common_fields.label: Consent Reported
common_fields.description:
Was informed consent reported? Leave empty when not stated.
0 - not: consent not reported
1 - informed consent reported: consent was obtained

common_fields.name: n_arms
common_fields.label: Number of Arms
common_fields.description: Number of independent experimental groups/conditions.

common_fields.name: design_factors
common_fields.label: Design Factors
common_fields.description: Array of manipulated factors, e.g. ["inoculation", "misinformation"] or ["credibility_badge", "social_norm"].

common_fields.name: factor_levels
common_fields.label: Factor Levels
common_fields.description: Array of objects, [{"factor": string, "levels": [string]}].

common_fields.name: within_between
common_fields.label: Within/Between
common_fields.description:
How were participants allocated?
1 - Between-subjects: each person sees one condition
2 - Within-subjects: every person sees all conditions
3 - Mixed: both between and within factors

common_fields.name: unit_of_analysis
common_fields.label: Unit of Analysis
common_fields.description:
The unit the analysis treats as one observation.
1 - Participant: person-level
2 - Item/headline: stimulus-level
3 - Dyad/group: pair- or group-level
4 - Other: say which

common_fields.name: clustering
common_fields.label: Clustering
common_fields.description: Clustering/random effects structure, e.g. "standard errors clustered by post", or null.

common_fields.name: control_group_type
common_fields.label: Control Group Type
common_fields.description:
What does the control arm receive?
1 - No-treatment/Passive: nothing or a neutral task
2 - Placebo (unrelated content): filler content, no intervention
3 - Active (alternative intervention): a different intervention
4 - Waitlist: the intervention comes later
5 - Misinformation-only: misinformation with no counter-content
6 - Other: say which

common_fields.name: Intervention_Type
common_fields.label: Intervention Type
common_fields.description:
The intervention families this experiment delivers (choose all; multi-type experiments are allowed).
inoculation - Inoculation: preemptive warning plus refutation builds resistance
prebunking_warning - Prebunking / warning: a brief warning shown before or beside content
lateral_reading - Lateral reading: leave the page, check the source elsewhere
credibility_labels - Source-credibility labels: trust badges or ratings on sources
media_literacy_tips - Media-literacy tips: short tips for spotting false content
fact_checking_training - Fact-checking training: a taught fact-checking workflow
openmindedness_intervention - Open-mindedness training: actively open-minded thinking, consider-the-opposite
debunking_and_rebuttals - Debunking / rebuttal: a correction shown after exposure
community_correction - Community correction: peer or community notes and flags
accuracy_prompts - Accuracy prompt: a nudge to think about accuracy
friction - Friction: an extra step or pause before sharing
social_norms - Social norms: descriptive or injunctive norm messages
platform_exposure_reduction - Platform exposure reduction: downranking, removal or deplatforming
other - Other: say what in Intervention Type Detail

common_fields.name: Intervention_Type_Detail
common_fields.label: Intervention Type Detail
common_fields.description: REQUIRED when Intervention_Type includes "other"; specify the combined/specific approach. Otherwise null.

common_fields.name: Intervention_Topic
common_fields.label: Intervention Topic
common_fields.description: Topic or domain of the intervention (e.g. vaccines, climate change), or null.

common_fields.name: Intervention_Duration
common_fields.label: Intervention Duration (minutes)
common_fields.description: Numeric duration of the intervention in minutes, or null.

common_fields.name: Modality
common_fields.label: Modality
common_fields.description:
How the intervention is delivered.
1 - Text: reading material
2 - Video: video clip or lecture
3 - Game/Gamified: game or interactive module
4 - Mixed: more than one modality
5 - Other (specify in detail/notes): say which
6 - Personal training: in-person training session

common_fields.name: Exposure_Schedule
common_fields.label: Exposure Schedule
common_fields.description:
How exposure to the intervention is scheduled.
1 - Single massed session: once, in one block
2 - Spaced (multiple continuous sessions): repeated over days
3 - Boosted (delayed follow-up session): an extra later session

common_fields.name: Pedagogy_Type
common_fields.label: Pedagogy Type
common_fields.description:
Teaching approach of the intervention.
1 - Direct Instruction: learners are told how to evaluate
2 - Guided Inquiry: guided discovery with prompts
3 - Co-created/Collaborative: learners produce the answers together

common_fields.name: Instructor_Type
common_fields.label: Instructor Type
common_fields.description:
Who delivers the intervention.
1 - Researcher: a study team member
2 - Teacher: a school or university teacher
3 - Peer: a fellow student or participant
4 - Computer: software delivers it
5 - Anthropomorphic Agent: a character, robot or AI persona
6 - Other: say who

common_fields.name: Feedback_Mechanics
common_fields.label: Feedback Mechanics
common_fields.description:
Does practice give feedback?
0 - None: no feedback
1 - Knowledge of Results (correct/incorrect): right/wrong only
2 - Elaborated (explanation): why the answer is right
3 - Forced Mastery: repeat until a criterion is met

common_fields.name: Attention_Cues
common_fields.label: Attention Cues
common_fields.description:
Cues that hold attention to the message (choose all).
Visual Signaling/Highlighting: content marked up or highlighted
Explicit Ignore Instructions: told to ignore the distractor
Physiological/Emotional Focus: bodily or emotional engagement cues

common_fields.name: Affective_Design
common_fields.label: Affective Design
common_fields.description:
Emotional design of the material.
0 - Neutral: no emotional framing
1 - Intentional Negative Trigger: fear or threat deliberately evoked
2 - Humor/Positive Reinforcement: humor or warmth

common_fields.name: Media_Support
common_fields.label: Media Support
common_fields.description:
Media that carry the intervention (choose all).
Visual aids: charts or infographics
Video: moving footage
Audio: sound only
Text: written material
Interactive/gamified: clickable or game-like
Model teaching: demonstration by a model
Physical materials: handouts or posters
Other: say which

common_fields.name: Comm_Strategies
common_fields.label: Communication Strategies
common_fields.description:
How the intervention communicates (choose all).
Sketching/narrative: drawn or story-based retelling
Verbal labelling: naming the techniques aloud
Interview techniques: question-and-answer practice
Group discussion: shared deliberation
Debate: structured pro versus con
Other: say which

common_fields.name: ICAP_Role
common_fields.label: ICAP Role
common_fields.description:
Learner engagement mode (ICAP).
1 - Passive: receives only
2 - Active: does something with the material
3 - Constructive: generates new content
4 - Interactive: co-creates with others

common_fields.name: Social_Context
common_fields.label: Social Context
common_fields.description:
Social setting of the intervention.
1 - Individual: done alone
2 - Prosocial: cooperative
3 - Competitive: contest framing

common_fields.name: Retrieval_Practice
common_fields.label: Retrieval Practice
common_fields.description:
Do learners retrieve the material from memory?
0 - Absent: no retrieval
1 - Present: recall is practised

common_fields.name: Contrasting_Cases
common_fields.label: Contrasting Cases
common_fields.description:
Are manipulative and neutral examples contrasted?
0 - No: no contrast
1 - Yes (manipulative vs. neutral examples): the two kinds are shown side by side

common_fields.name: Concept_Labeling
common_fields.label: Concept Labeling
common_fields.description:
Is the manipulation concept named?
0 - Implicit: techniques not named
1 - Explicit: the concept is labelled

common_fields.name: Interleaving
common_fields.label: Interleaving
common_fields.description:
Is practice mixed or blocked?
0 - Blocked: one type at a time
1 - Interleaved: types mixed together

common_fields.name: Practice_Strategy
common_fields.label: Practice Strategy
common_fields.description:
Practice formats used (choose all).
Recall tests: retrieval quizzes
Easy-to-hard sequencing: difficulty ramps up
Classification/sorting: sorting items into types
Compare-and-contrast: side-by-side comparison
Self-explanation/reflection: explain your own answer
Guided practice: scaffolded exercises
Feedback-based practice: practice driven by feedback
Media production: making media oneself
Other: say which

common_fields.name: Self_Efficacy
common_fields.label: Self-Efficacy Support
common_fields.description:
Is learner confidence explicitly supported?
0 - No: no support
1 - Yes (explicit support/indicators): mastery feedback or efficacy prompts

common_fields.name: Synthetic
common_fields.label: Synthetic Stimuli
common_fields.description:
Are the stimuli fabricated for the study?
1 - Synthetic: made up for the study
2 - Real: real published content
3 - Mixed: both kinds

common_fields.name: Stimuli
common_fields.label: Stimuli Type
common_fields.description:
What the stimuli are.
1 - Headlines: headline-style posts
2 - Claims: standalone claims
3 - Source: source information alone
4 - Headline+Claim: both
5 - Claim+Source: both
6 - Headline+Source: both
7 - Video: video stimuli
8 - Images: picture stimuli
9 - Other: say which

common_fields.name: Stimuli_Topic
common_fields.label: Stimuli Topic
common_fields.description: Topic or domain of the stimuli, or null.

common_fields.name: Rationale_Notes
common_fields.label: Rationale Notes
common_fields.description: Brief note on inferred values, group-size inference, and effect-size conversions. Empty string if none.

common_fields.name: Fulltext_Exclusion_Criterion
common_fields.label: Full-text exclusion criterion (C1-C4)
common_fields.description:
Leave EMPTY when the study meets every inclusion criterion. Otherwise list the unmet criterion/criteria: C1 = No misinformation intervention; C2 = No control/comparison group; C3 = Not English; C4 = Not a primary experimental study. A study that fails a criterion is STILL fully coded, harmonized and reproduced as normal.
C1 - No misinformation intervention (C1)
C2 - No control/comparison group (C2)
C3 - Not English (C3)
C4 - Not a primary experimental study (C4)
insufficient reporting - the study ran, but no eligible contrast is reported
fulltext irretrievable - no obtainable copy
duplicate of an included study - non-independent report

options.label: insufficient reporting (study ran, but no eligible contrast is reported)
duplicate of an included study (non-independent report)

common_fields.name: Corresponding_Author_Name
common_fields.label: Corresponding author (name)
common_fields.description: Name of the author the paper directs correspondence to, e.g. "Jane Roe". Empty when the paper names no corresponding author. Recorded separately from the address in 'Corresponding_Author_Email'.

common_fields.name: Corresponding_Author_Email
common_fields.label: Corresponding author (email)
common_fields.description: E-mail address of the corresponding author, as printed in the paper. Empty when no address is printed or none could be resolved to the corresponding author.

common_fields.name: Corresponding_Author_Source
common_fields.label: Corresponding author (source)
common_fields.description: Where the corresponding author was read from, e.g. "pdf: correspondence note, p. 1" or "openalex: corresponding_author_ids".

dv_fields.name: dv_name
dv_fields.label: DV Name
dv_fields.description: Name/label of the dependent variable.

dv_fields.name: dv_domain
dv_fields.label: DV Domains
dv_fields.description:
The outcome's domain (choose all).
technique_recognition - Technique recognition: spotting manipulation tactics
credibility - Credibility: perceived accuracy or credibility of claims/sources
sharing_intention - Sharing intention: willingness to share
search_behavior - Search behavior: information-seeking actions
attitude_policy - Attitude/policy: opinions or policy views
trust - Trust: trust in media or institutions
media_literacy_attitudes - Media-literacy attitudes: confidence in one's skills
critical_thinking - Critical thinking: general reasoning
other - Other: say which in the DV name

dv_fields.name: score_types
dv_fields.label: Score Types
dv_fields.description:
How the score is computed (choose all).
separate_true - Separate true: true items scored alone
separate_false - Separate false: false items scored alone
separate_manipulative - Separate manipulative: manipulative items scored alone
separate_nonmanipulative - Separate non-manipulative: clean items scored alone
discernment_difference - Discernment difference: true minus false
composite - Composite: items pooled into one score
signal_detection_auc - SDT AUC: area under the ROC curve
signal_detection_d_prime - SDT d': sensitivity (zHit minus zFA)
signal_detection_c - SDT c: response bias
signal_detection_other - SDT other: another signal-detection index
dichotomous_accuracy - Dichotomous accuracy: 0/1 correct
continuous_accuracy - Continuous accuracy: graded accuracy
proportion - Proportion: a share of responses
proportion_difference - Proportion difference: difference of shares
behavioral_choice - Behavioral choice: an option chosen
count - Count: a number of instances
single_item - Single item: one item only
behavioral_intention - Behavioral intention: self-reported intent
change_score - Change score: post minus pre
other - Other: describe it in Discernment Defined As

dv_fields.name: discernment_defined_as
dv_fields.label: Discernment Defined As
dv_fields.description: How a difference/discernment score is computed, e.g. "manipulative minus non-manipulative", or null.

dv_fields.name: dv_polarity
dv_fields.label: DV Polarity
dv_fields.description:
Direction of a good score (per DV, never assumed).
1 - higher score is better/protective: more discernment or accuracy
0 - higher score is worse: more misinformation belief or sharing
(empty = not applicable)

dv_fields.name: scale_type
dv_fields.label: Scale Type
dv_fields.description:
The response scale's form.
1 - Limited Likert: fixed points (e.g. 1-7)
2 - Slider/continuous: any value in a range
3 - Proportion/percentage: 0-100 share
4 - Count: a number of instances
5 - Signal-detection index: d', AUC or c
6 - Dichotomous: two values
7 - Other: say which

dv_fields.name: scale_points
dv_fields.label: Scale Points
dv_fields.description: Number of response scale points, if applicable.

dv_fields.name: scale_min
dv_fields.label: Scale Min
dv_fields.description: Minimum possible score/value.

dv_fields.name: scale_max
dv_fields.label: Scale Max
dv_fields.description: Maximum possible score/value.

dv_fields.name: comparison_label
dv_fields.label: Comparison Label
dv_fields.description: Label of the specific contrast and timepoint, e.g. "Good Bad Vaxx vs Control (post)".

dv_fields.name: group1_label
dv_fields.label: Group 1 Label
dv_fields.description: First group name in the comparison.

dv_fields.name: group2_label
dv_fields.label: Group 2 Label
dv_fields.description: Second group name in the comparison.

dv_fields.name: contrast_type
dv_fields.label: Contrast Type
dv_fields.description:
Which two cells this contrast compares.
1 - Primary treatment vs no-treatment control
2 - Treatment vs active/placebo control
3 - Dose-response: different doses compared
4 - Within-person: the same people, pre vs post
5 - Factorial main effect: one factor's average
6 - Simple effect: one cell of a factorial
7 - Other: describe it
8 - Misinformation vs no misinformation
9 - Informative message vs control
10 - Factorial interaction: factors jointly
11 - Omnibus model term: a whole-model test - never the eligible primary effect
12 - Moderator main effect: a moderator's average
13 - Non-intervention factor: a factor that is not the intervention

dv_fields.name: eligible_primary
dv_fields.label: Eligible Primary
dv_fields.description:
Is this the contrast the meta-analysis pools?
1 - eligible primary meta-analytic contrast (intervention vs no-inoculation control): the intervention versus a control that got no misinformation intervention
0 - not primary: any other contrast

options.label: eligible primary meta-analytic contrast (intervention vs no-inoculation control)

dv_fields.name: timepoint_1
dv_fields.label: Timepoint 1
dv_fields.description: First timepoint label, e.g. "post", "followup_4w", "pre".

dv_fields.name: timepoint_2
dv_fields.label: Timepoint 2
dv_fields.description: Second timepoint label, or null for cross-sectional single-time contrasts.

dv_fields.name: posttest_type
dv_fields.label: Posttest Type
dv_fields.description:
When the outcome is measured.
1 - Immediate: right after the intervention
2 - Delayed: at a follow-up
3 - Both: immediate and delayed
4 - Cross-sectional: one shot, no post
5 - Other: say which

dv_fields.name: delay_weeks
dv_fields.label: Delay (weeks)
dv_fields.description: Numeric delay in weeks; null if only immediate effects are reported.

dv_fields.name: n1i_pre
dv_fields.label: N Pre Group 1
dv_fields.description: Pre-test sample size group 1.

dv_fields.name: m1i_pre
dv_fields.label: Mean Pre Group 1
dv_fields.description: Pre-test mean group 1.

dv_fields.name: sd1i_pre
dv_fields.label: SD Pre Group 1
dv_fields.description: Pre-test SD group 1.

dv_fields.name: n2i_pre
dv_fields.label: N Pre Group 2
dv_fields.description: Pre-test sample size group 2.

dv_fields.name: m2i_pre
dv_fields.label: Mean Pre Group 2
dv_fields.description: Pre-test mean group 2.

dv_fields.name: sd2i_pre
dv_fields.label: SD Pre Group 2
dv_fields.description: Pre-test SD group 2.

dv_fields.name: n1i_post
dv_fields.label: N Post Group 1
dv_fields.description: Post-test sample size group 1.

dv_fields.name: m1i_post
dv_fields.label: Mean Post Group 1
dv_fields.description: Post-test mean group 1.

dv_fields.name: sd1i_post
dv_fields.label: SD Post Group 1
dv_fields.description: Post-test SD group 1.

dv_fields.name: n2i_post
dv_fields.label: N Post Group 2
dv_fields.description: Post-test sample size group 2.

dv_fields.name: m2i_post
dv_fields.label: Mean Post Group 2
dv_fields.description: Post-test mean group 2.

dv_fields.name: sd2i_post
dv_fields.label: SD Post Group 2
dv_fields.description: Post-test SD group 2.

dv_fields.name: n1i
dv_fields.label: N Group 1
dv_fields.description: Sample size group 1 for the tested timepoint (metafor alias).

dv_fields.name: m1i
dv_fields.label: Mean Group 1
dv_fields.description: Mean group 1 for the tested timepoint (metafor alias).

dv_fields.name: sd1i
dv_fields.label: SD Group 1
dv_fields.description: SD group 1 for the tested timepoint (metafor alias).

dv_fields.name: n2i
dv_fields.label: N Group 2
dv_fields.description: Sample size group 2 for the tested timepoint (metafor alias).

dv_fields.name: m2i
dv_fields.label: Mean Group 2
dv_fields.description: Mean group 2 for the tested timepoint (metafor alias).

dv_fields.name: sd2i
dv_fields.label: SD Group 2
dv_fields.description: SD group 2 for the tested timepoint (metafor alias).

dv_fields.name: t_val
dv_fields.label: t Statistic
dv_fields.description: Exact t-test statistic.

dv_fields.name: F_val
dv_fields.label: F Statistic
dv_fields.description: Exact F-statistic.

dv_fields.name: df_num
dv_fields.label: df Numerator
dv_fields.description: Numerator df for F-tests.

dv_fields.name: df_den
dv_fields.label: df Denominator
dv_fields.description: Denominator df for F-tests.

dv_fields.name: z_val
dv_fields.label: z Statistic

accuracy_prompts.label: Accuracy Prompts
